test_design_decisions: stale_after boundary: age >= 60 000 ms is stale (register: 'age at which it is labeled stale: 60 s'); 59 999 ms is fresh
a value without a source timestamp is never shown as fresh
text floor checked as sp >= px floor (1 sp >= 1 px at any 1080p density >= mdpi); on-stick px measurement stays with P2-A05
PANEL_ROWS_MAX must be declared in 20..64; a state above it is rejected whole, not truncated
remote: each PanelAction must be bound to a key the Fire TV remote delivers; the specific key is the product's choice
a hidden panel suspends update application, never fetches, does not consume D-pad focus keys, and fetches immediately on show
